parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables WPS functionality for this EasyMesh agent or single AP.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the current status of WPS. If the device goes to {{enum|SetupLocked}} the WPS needs to be disabled and re-enabled to come out of this state.

object.description: This object contains Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) Push Button Configuration (PBC) configuration and status as specified in {{bibref|WPSv1.0}} or {{bibref|WPS 2.0}}). In EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} this object applies to fronthaul only.
